newsitem.title: LATVIA: IBCA OFFERS ANOTHER RATING FOR LATVIA.
newsitem.headline: IBCA OFFERS ANOTHER RATING FOR LATVIA.

text.p: International credit rating agency IBCA has offered to give Latvia another credit rating although Finance Minister Robert Zile has not yet accepted the offer, the finance ministry said on Monday.
It said in a statement that the offer was made during a meeting between Zile and IBCA in London. Zile is in the British capital for the EBRD meeting.

"During an official meeting with credit rating agency IBCA, Latvia was offered the possibility of a credit rating, taking into account that this agency is more orientated to attracting European investments and takes political aspects more into account," the finance ministry said in a statement.
Zile told the agency that Latvia may be interested in a rating but only if the big give Latvian banks were also interested.
Latvia already has an S&P investment grade BBB rating.
